# B4 — APK commits sneaking into the repo

**Section**: B. Release, signing, storage
**Keywords**: apks, binaries, cached, commits, empty, gitignored, history, ignore, ls-files, picked, release, repo, signing, sneaking, storage, tracked, verify

## Problem

APK commits sneaking into the repo

## Root cause

git add -A picked up 3x126 MB APKs in a gitignored dir (tracked before ignore added)

## Solution

git rm --cached; verify git ls-files empty; keep binaries out of git history
